title_zh: 确定漏水传感器试点的比较指标

scenario.label_zh: 制定漏水传感器试点的比较指标
scenario.goal_zh: 区分检测效果与检查效率，并约定记录漏检、误报及人工时间

context_zh: 设施团队准备在训练用水槽中比较两款漏水传感器，不涉及真实紧急情况。
author: author-phase10-c

sentences.speaker: Jae
sentences.text: The sales sheet promises faster leak detection. How do we test that fairly?

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: We need empirical evidence from our own trial, not just a demonstration chosen by the seller.

sentences.speaker: Jae
sentences.text: Can we devise a test using the training tanks and the same small leaks for both sensors?

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Yes. To measure effectiveness, record missed leaks and false alarms as well as successful alerts.

sentences.speaker: Jae
sentences.text: And efficiency would include how much staff time the checks take?

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Exactly. A sensor can detect leaks well and still take too much work to maintain.

sentences.speaker: Jae
sentences.text: Then I will prepare a sheet with those three results and staff time, and we will test both sensors under the same conditions.

sentences.speaker: Morgan
sentences.text: Agreed. Let me check the sheet before the trial starts.

targets.sense_zh: 以观察或实验为依据的
